resolved_conflicts.explanation: tnlandforms gives 807 ft for the site (its page gives no metres; 246 m is that figure converted); the NGS sheet gives 810 ft (247 m) NAVD 88 at its survey mark. Different measurements of nearby ground; the record keeps 246 m.

notes_for_editor: Do not conflate with the Pinewood Fire Tower in Bemidji, Minnesota (us-mn-pinewood and us-mn-pinewood-at-forestry-education-center); it is a different tower. Wikipedia's Hickman County NRHP list has a 'Pinewood' at Pinewood Rd., Nunnelly (ref 71001072), listed 1971 and delisted 1975 after a fire on 15 March 1975. No source I found ties it to this lookout, so it is not used in the story; worth checking. Elevation: tnlandforms gives 807 ft (its page has no metres; 246 m is the conversion), the NGS sheet 810 ft (247 m, NAVD 88); the record keeps 246 m, a measurement difference, not an error. NGS coordinates are about 50 m from the record point. The NGS sheet also says observations were made from a 77-foot tower; it does not say whether that was this lookout, so it is left out.
